Resolves #19735

The retained Antigravity rules path now points to shared `AGENTS.md` guidance instead of assigning a fixed peer identity or duplicating execution and sunset policy. Its existing formatting reminder remains, with scoped repair replacing reset-to-HEAD. The worktree concept points to Brain's bootstrap and managed Start owners instead of prescribing Engine-local commands.

Evidence: L1 (source, link and byte audit) → L1 required (documentation retirement only). No residual close-target ACs.

## Deltas from ticket

None beyond the preservation decisions already folded into the ticket.

## Slot rationale and load-effect audit

`rewrite/retire` under ADR 0007: preserve the existing path and canonical pointer; remove stale per-session identity and duplicated lifecycle policy. The existing source-formatting reminder stays compressed until the shared-placement gap recorded on the ticket has an owner. Frequency: potentially every Antigravity turn; severity: identity/permission drift and lost local work; enforcement: existing harness permissions, shared gates and source checks.

The extra `SafeToAutoRun: false` policy is explicitly retired. Actual harness permissions and the shared human-only merge/protected-branch gates remain authoritative; no permission config changes. The pointer does not claim to override harness system instructions.

The legacy `context.fileName` declaration was observed; consumption by the current native loader remains unproved. Existing `../AGENTS.md` resolves. No hook, native rule registration, global config or seat-memory carrier changes. Native loading remains in [Brain #1017](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/1017).

## Test Evidence

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here. The shared PR Baseline supplies `pr-body` and `substrate-size` checks.
